record.original_question: Can you recover certain derivatives of the Levi form at a weakly pseudoconvex point in terms of the weighted boundary behavior of the Kobayashi metric?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.5.6 Can you recover certain derivatives of the Levi form at a weakly pseudoconvex point in terms of the weighted boundary behavior of the Kobayashi metric? -S. Krantz, sk@math.wustl.edu 7.6 Regular Domains

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain with defining function $\rho$, and let $p \in \partial \Omega$ be a weakly pseudoconvex boundary point (i.e., the Levi form $L_p(\xi,\bar\xi) = \sum_{j,k} \frac{\partial^2 \rho}{\partial z_j \partial \bar z_k}(p)\,\xi_j \bar\xi_k$, restricted to the complex tangent space $T^{1,0}_p(\partial\Omega)$, is positive semidefinite but degenerate). Let $F_\Omega(z,\xi)$ denote the Kobayashi–Royden infinitesimal metric on $\Omega$, where for $z \in \Omega$ and $\xi \in \mathbb{C}^n$,
$$F_\Omega(z,\xi) = \inf\{\,|\alpha| : \exists\,\phi : \mathbb{D} \to \Omega \text{ holomorphic with } \phi(0)=z,\ \phi'(0)=\xi/\alpha\,\}.$$
For a multi-index of weights associated to a system of local coordinates around $p$ adapted to $\partial\Omega$ (e.g., normalized so that complex normal and complex tangential directions are separated and weighted by powers of the boundary distance $\delta(z) = \mathrm{dist}(z,\partial\Omega)$), study the asymptotic behavior of $F_\Omega(z,\xi)$ as $z \to p$ non-tangentially, with $\xi$ taken in tangential or normal directions and scaled by the appropriate weights.

Question: Can one recover certain higher-order derivatives of the Levi form at the weakly pseudoconvex point $p$ from this weighted boundary behavior of the Kobayashi metric? More precisely, identify explicit weighted asymptotic functionals built from $F_\Omega(z,\xi)$ as $z \to p$ whose limits compute prescribed derivatives (of specified order) of the Levi form coefficients at $p$.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search located related results on boundary behavior of the Kobayashi metric on weakly pseudoconvex (in particular finite-type and Levi corank one) domains, where leading-order asymptotics encode the Levi form itself. However, no source was found that explicitly settles the recovery of higher-order derivatives of the Levi form at weakly pseudoconvex points from weighted Kobayashi-metric asymptotics in the generality asked. The status appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Boundary Behavior of the Kobayashi Metric
status_evidence.snippet: Krantz's 1992 paper studying boundary asymptotics of F(z,ξ) and the appearance of the Levi form at leading order.
status_evidence.claim: Existing results recover the Levi form (not its higher derivatives) from leading asymptotics of the Kobayashi metric.

status_evidence.title: Bounds for invariant distances on pseudoconvex Levi corank one domains
status_evidence.snippet: Sharp bounds for Kobayashi/Carathéodory metrics on Levi corank one pseudoconvex domains in terms of weighted polydiscs.
status_evidence.claim: Weighted boundary behavior of invariant metrics is well studied, but extraction of higher Levi-form derivatives is not stated.

status_evidence.title: Boundary Behavior of the Kobayashi–Royden Metric in smooth pseudoconvex domains
status_evidence.snippet: Studies precise boundary asymptotics of the Kobayashi–Royden metric in smooth pseudoconvex domains.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit recovery of higher-order Levi form derivatives from weighted Kobayashi asymptotics is reported.
